sections.title: Welcome
sections.text:
This sample trip shows what River Guide can hold: crew and crafts, a day-by-day itinerary with sunrise and sunset, meals, a gear list that splits costs, shuttle planning, a ledger and a trip log.

The people and plans here are made up. Create your own trip from the Trips tab; you can delete this one under Settings.

sections.title: Reference notes
sections.text: Trips can also carry read-only reference material such as outfitter Q&A, shopping lists and meeting notes. Import a trip backup (General → About → Restore) to bring in your own.
